notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources reached are the association's county list (tower gone, coordinates only) and the Wikipedia article on the peak, which describes the present radio towers and does not mention a lookout. No build date, design, staffing or fire history was found, and nothing says whether the lookout's remains are still on the summit. Access is not recorded: the road is described as dead-end and dirt, and no source says whether it is open to the public. The association's coordinates sit close to the Wikipedia summit coordinates, so the two probably refer to the same peak.
